questions.q: Two particles are projected vertically upwards from the surface of the earth with velocities ${v}_{1} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2gR}{3}}$ and ${v}_{2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{4gR}{3}}$ respectively. If the maximum heights attained by the two particles are ${h}_{1}$ and ${h}_{2}$ respectively, then calculate the ratio $\dfrac{{h}_{1}}{{h}_{2}}$.
questions.solution:
Loss of $KE =$ Gain in $PE$

$⇒ \dfrac{1}{2}{mv}^{2} = mgh \left(\dfrac{R}{h + R}\right)$

CASE I.

$⇒ \dfrac{1}{2}m\left(\dfrac{2gR}{3}\right) = {mgh}_{1}\left(\dfrac{R}{{h}_{1} + R}\right)$ ...(i)

$⇒ \dfrac{1}{2}m\left(\dfrac{4gR}{3}\right) = {mgh}_{2}\left(\dfrac{R}{{h}_{2} + R}\right)$ ...(ii)

Solving (i)

$⇒ \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{{h}_{1}}{{h}_{1} + R}$

$⇒ {h}_{1} = \dfrac{R}{2}$ ...(iii)

Solving (ii)

$⇒ \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{{h}_{2}}{{h}_{2} + R}$ ...(iv)

$⇒ {h}_{2} = 2R$

From (iii) and (iv)

$⇒ \dfrac{{h}_{1}}{{h}_{2}} = \dfrac{R / 2}{2R}$

$∴ \dfrac{{h}_{1}}{{h}_{2}} = \dfrac{1}{4} = 0 . 25$

questions.q: A spherical hole of radius $\frac{R}{2}$ is drilled from a planet of mass $M$ as shown in the figure. If the gravitational acceleration at a point on the surface of the planet just above the hole is $\mathrm{N} \times 1.1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$, find the value of N . [Given: $G=6.6 \times 10^{-11} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{m}^2 / \mathrm{kg}^2, R=6 \times 10^6 \mathrm{~m}, M=6 \times 10^{24} \mathrm{~kg}$ ]
questions.solution:
If there were no hole
$g_0=\frac{G M}{R^2}$
decrease in g due to hole (absent mass)
$\mathrm{g}_1=\frac{\mathrm{GM} / 8}{(\mathrm{R} / 2)^2}=\frac{\mathrm{GM}}{2 \mathrm{R}^2}$
effective $\mathrm{g}=\mathrm{g}_0-\mathrm{g}_1$
$\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{G M}{2 R^2} \\
& =5.5 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2
\end{aligned}$
